task: Fix mobile layout clipping at the bottom of the screen (Buy button cutoff)
context: On mobile devices, flexbox containers are artificially restricting their height to the viewport, which cuts off overflow content like the Buy button at the bottom of the dashboard cards. Mobile browser navigation bars also overlap the bottom edge.
instructions: Add a new CSS rule inside the media query targeting `.dash-left-col, .dash-right-col, .dash-trades-panel, .dash-card, .buy-more-card, .trade-card`.

Inside that rule, apply `height: auto !important;`, `min-height: auto !important;`, `flex: none !important;`, and `overflow: visible !important;` to force the containers to expand to their full content height.
Add another CSS rule inside the media query targeting `.dash-split-wrapper, .buy-more-layout`.
Inside that rule, apply `padding-bottom: 120px !important;` to ensure the bottom-most content can be scrolled comfortably above any floating browser toolbars.
expected_outcome: The dashboard cards will expand vertically to reveal all inner content, including the Buy button, and the user will be able to scroll all the way down without the browser's bottom UI obstructing the view.
